newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares hit new all-time high in IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares hit new all-time high in IBIS trade.

text.p: 0645 GMT - German shares reach new all-time high in pre-bourse IBIS computer trade as market finds strength from overnight Wall Street gains and dollar stable above 1.74 marks. Traders expect market to consolidate at current levels before further extending gains. Little corporate news expected today.
* IBIS DAX up 6.04 points at 3,840.88 points. DAX ended bourse on Tuesday up 34.08 points at 3, 819.85 points.
* DIW institute sees German 1997 jobless level at 4.4 million, over 4.6 million in 1998.
* Telekom slightly down after says in pact with Kirch and CLT to launch digital television in Germany.
